meaning:
§ Amon or Amun = "to nourish: to be faithful"
an Egyptian god, originally the local god of Thebes, later head of the Egyptian pantheon

elsewhere.note: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods, and her kings; even Pharaoh, and those who…
Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her; whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?
